title: Make the placement probe carry role-sized prompts
goal: The placement probe carries Casper's and Misato's own system messages unchanged, on P2 and across WorkerLink for P3
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures and the gauntlet packs only; local models on the enrolled NERV-01 and NERV-02 over Tailscale; 0 paid cloud tokens; raw reports stay in ~/.nerv-private on their base; NERV-01's live service (~/.nerv-app, ~/.nerv) is never stopped, updated or edited.
acceptance: The placement probe carries a system message and prompts the size of Misato's (about 18,000 characters), with validated limits and a regression test
The remote inference contract carries a system message that size between bases, with a test across the HTTP route, the runtime and WorkerLink
validation: Recorded evidence for this slice; scoped checks and required CI
escalation: Stop on unclear ownership, missing prerequisites, privacy changes or uncertain external effects
A stop rule of the placement campaign aborts the run without fallback or retry
Anything that needs a credential, an unreachable host or the owner goes back to the owner; NERV-02 is left running

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 (F-006-T26): probe field and limit change with tests (1 h), rerun and evidence update (1 h). Split 2026-11-24: the rerun needs both bases updated (owner, F-006-T28) and moved to F-006-T29.
